Buyer questions

Can we create our own cosmic academy artwork?

Yes. Develop your own rocket, astronaut, comic or academy graphic direction. Supply authorized logos and approve the panel artwork before sampling.

What fabric composition and GSM are used?

Confirm fiber percentages, weight, stretch recovery and moisture management against the approved material specification. Request a swatch and fit sample.

What construction should we approve?

The supplied brief specifies four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching, raglan sleeves and a reinforced extended hem. Verify seam finish, measurements and movement on the sample.

Are the detail images production photographs?

The two training-floor images are customer photographs. The three close-up illustrations and video are supplied design presentations; refer to the approved physical sample for production details.
